title: High-Dimensional Simulation-Based Inference in Latent Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2609.37381v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural simulation-based inference (SBI) has been widely successful in inferring a relatively small number of interpretable parameters from potentially high-dimensional observations, such as images or time series. Accordingly, representation learning in SBI has focused almost exclusively on compressing the observations used to condition the posterior. More recently, however, SBI has begun to target increasingly high-dimensional parameter spaces, raising the complementary question of whether the inference target itself should be compressed. Our answer is a practical merger of SBI and latent generative modeling, which learns a low-dimensional representation of the simulator parameters, performs posterior inference directly in this latent space, and maps posterior samples back to the original parameter space. translated_title: 潜在空间中的高维基于模拟的推断
translated_abstract: 神经基于模拟的推断（SBI）已在从可能高维的观测（如图像或时间序列）中推断相对少量可解释参数方面取得了广泛成功。相应地，SBI中的表示学习几乎完全专注于压缩用于对后验进行条件化的观测数据。然而，近年来SBI开始面向日益高维的参数空间，这引出了一个互补的问题：推断目标本身是否也应该被压缩。我们的答案是 将SBI与潜在生成式建模进行实用的融合，即学习模拟器参数的低维表示，直接在该潜在空间中执行后验推断，并将后验样本映射回原始参数空间。我们刻画了潜在空间推断能够恢复目标后验分布的条件，并系统地研究了其有效性。
tldr: 提出将基于模拟的推断与潜在生成式建模相融合的新框架，通过学习模拟器参数的低维表示、在潜在空间中直接进行后验推断再将样本映射回原始参数空间，从而解决高维参数空间的推断问题，并给出了潜在空间推断恢复目标后验分布的理论条件。
en_tdlr: Proposes a practical merger of simulation-based inference and latent generative modeling—learning a low-dimensional representation of simulator parameters, performing posterior inference directly in the latent space, and mapping samples back to the original space—to enable high-dimensional SBI, with theoretical conditions under which latent-space inference recovers the target posterior.
